bootstrap.method: Percentile bootstrap over the fixed held-out test rows; 7,500 rows sampled with replacement per resample.

near_duplicate_analysis.method: global StandardScaler over six numeric features; Euclidean distance; candidate pairs require identical produce_type and storage_type

OOD_image_validation.reason: Reliable extraction of all eight shelf-life inputs from unrelated/random images is unavailable; image-only testing would omit temperature, humidity, harvest age, and storage type. No synthetic shelf-life labels were created.

dataset_provenance.evidence: CSV has no documented collection/provenance record in inspected artifacts.
dataset_provenance.observed_result: Unknown provenance; no independent source evidence.
dataset_provenance.limitation: Cannot establish real-world source or sampling process.

target_quality.evidence: 8634 exact 0.5-day targets; target minimum 0.50; no target measurement documentation.
target_quality.limitation: The 0.5-day mass may reflect a floor or labeling convention; reason unknown.

random_split_validity.evidence: Seeded random split reproduces saved metrics; no specimen/batch/study IDs are present.
random_split_validity.limitation: Hidden relatedness or generated rules may cross partitions.

train_test_similarity.evidence: 45 same-category pairs are within 0.10 standardized Euclidean distance.
train_test_similarity.observed_result: Similar numeric profiles exist; exact input vectors are unique.
train_test_similarity.limitation: Nearness threshold is exploratory and supports interpolation across partitions.

feature_sufficiency.evidence: Random-test R2=0.9506; nearest-neighbor target-difference median=1.070 days.
feature_sufficiency.observed_result: Features fit this table well overall but close profiles can have target spread.
feature_sufficiency.limitation: No independent or longitudinal validation establishes sufficiency.

long_tail_performance.evidence: Range-specific metrics are recorded for >20–40 and >40 days.
long_tail_performance.limitation: Absolute error increases in long-life ranges.

short_shelf_life_performance.evidence: 0.5-day test subset n=1313, MAE=1.091, signed bias=1.089.
short_shelf_life_performance.observed_result: Floor labels are a large and heterogeneous subgroup.

ood_validation.observed_result: Reliable 8-feature extraction from unrelated images unavailable.

production_input_realism.evidence: Current shelf-life agent uses quality_score as both freshness_score and quality_score; production defaults include storage_type='ambient'.
production_input_realism.observed_result: Training has separate freshness and quality fields and storage vocabulary is Cold Storage, Controlled Atmosphere, Open Market, Refrigerated, Room Temperature.
production_input_realism.limitation: Input semantics/defaults and unknown categories require controlled validation.
